title: Physical Design Engineer
summary: Turns a chip block's synthesised netlist into a manufacturable layout by placing cells, building clock trees and routing wires until timing, power and layout rules all pass. Sits in the VLSI backend team between RTL designers and the tape-out (final handoff to the factory).
dailyDuties: Floorplan blocks and plan the power grid
Run placement, clock tree synthesis and routing in Innovus or ICC2
Fix setup and hold violations from timing reports
Clean DRC and LVS errors before signoff
Check IR drop and electromigration results
Write Tcl or Python scripts to speed up the flow

skills.expectation: Take blocks from netlist to GDS: floorplan, placement, clock tree synthesis and routing in Innovus or ICC2
Close setup and hold timing with static timing analysis across corners and drive timing ECOs
Clean DRC, LVS and antenna errors in Calibre or a similar tool before tape-out
Run IR drop and electromigration checks and strengthen the power grid where they fail
Understand CMOS cells, clocking and sequential logic behind each timing path
Run EDA flows and read tool logs on Linux compute farms
Script flow steps and report parsing in Tcl or Perl
Script flow steps and report parsing in Python
Implement multi-voltage blocks with UPF power intent and power gating
Run logic equivalence checks after netlist changes and ECOs
Keep flow scripts and constraints in version control

groups.label: A flow scripting language (Tcl/Perl or Python)
